page.notes: Marginal note beside "argumenta", marked with an asterisk, is printed in italic in the left margin. Its reading is uncertain at "Singul'ahac spar-"/"fim": it appears to read "Singularia haec sparsim habentur in hoc libro." Transcribed as read in the note below. Note on the left margin: "Singularia haec sparsim habentur in hoc libro." (doubtful reading of the word after "haec", and of "sparsim"). The small italic phrase inside the line after "nempè," is not legible and is marked as illegible. The top quotation carries an asterisk mark and a reference "Pag.27."; the mark is printed as "*" and is copied as {*}. Running head: the chapter marker "Cap.2." printed at right is not included in running_head, because it is a numbered marker, not part of the title. The word "nouo" is split at the line end ("no" / catchword "uo"); the last line is kept as printed.
